info.name: SKINIC API
info.description:
SKINIC Skin Intelligence REST API — api.skinic.app

Setup:
1. Import this collection
2. Create environment with `api_key` = your sk-... key from skinic.app/dashboard
3. Start with GET /health, then POST /analyze

Get a free key: https://skinic.app/signup?product=api
Docs: https://api.skinic.app

request.description:
Single-frame skin analysis. Returns full AnalyzeResponse — skin type, 8 traits, health score, lesions, colour season, 128-dim fingerprint.

Counts toward monthly analyze quota (Free: 20/mo).

request.description:
Rank YOUR product catalog against a skin profile. Returns match_score + match_reasons per item.

Does NOT consume analyze quota.

Tip: tag products with skin_type_tags and trait_tags for best matches.

Alternative: pass analyze_result from POST /analyze instead of skin_type + top_traits.
Pipe POST /analyze output directly — no need to extract skin_type and traits manually.

Ingredient guide for skin type + concerns.

Free tier: static guide.
Starter+: SKINIC AI + 551-ingredient knowledge base.
